     1	# EPIC design — multi-project runner routing (v3, post-3-way-audit)

     4	
     5	## Premise correction (from the 3-way audit, VERDICT NEEDS-WORK)
     6	v2 claimed "just generalize the camviewpro lane + push via `resolve_gerrit_push_identity`." The audit (me + sub-agent + codex, file:line-cited; `docs/audit/codex-reviews/case5-runner-routing-{codex,subagent}-2026-06-14.txt`) proved that is wrong:
     7	- The self-tenant path **hardcodes BOTH the develop-baseline FETCH and the refs/for PUSH to `omnisight/OmniSight-Productizer`** (`jira_dispatch.py:502,660-665,842-851,1194-1199`). Pushing "via the normal identity path" literally targets productizer.
     8	- Routing by `project_key` is useless — all conf tickets live in JIRA project **OP**, which resolves to the productizer default (`delivery_target.py:132-134`).
     9	- The camviewpro lane is **GitHub-PR-specific** (`open_contribution_pr`, `camviewpro-ro`, GPT-5.5 co-author) — not a Gerrit router.
    10	- `repo:` routing isn't at the dispatch seam; a typo'd label **silently falls through to productizer** (the very mis-pickup we meant to kill). Fail-closed needs an explicit pre-gate.
    11	- Shared Gerrit gates (backpressure / file-mutex / staleness) are **not project-scoped** → conf changes can pause productizer runners + cause false same-path collisions.
    12	- conference-appliance Gerrit ACL `inheritFrom=All-Projects` ≠ productizer governance (no AI+1/human+2 submit-rule). claude-bot CAN push refs/for (verified, change 1584) but the review gate is absent.
    13	
    14	**Conclusion: this is a real, multi-ticket runner-core feature, not a small change.** This doc re-architects it properly.
    15	
    16	## Target architecture
    17	A **routed-repo descriptor** resolved per-ticket from a `repo:<name>` LABEL (not tenant, not project_key), threaded through the runner's fetch → CLI-cwd → push, with the existing self-tenant productizer path untouched as the default (the safe floor). Concretely:
    18	
    19	```
    20	RoutedRepo = { name, gerrit_url, ref="refs/for/develop", git_account_ref, push_identity }
    21	```
    22	
    23	1. **Routing config + resolver.** A settings map `routed_repos` keyed by `repo:<name>` → RoutedRepo. `resolve_routed_repo(labels)`:
    24	   - no `repo:` label → `None` (normal productizer path, unchanged).
    25	   - `repo:` present AND resolves → the RoutedRepo.
    26	   - `repo:` present AND unresolved/malformed → **raise** (fail-closed). REQUIRED config (not the fail-open `delivery_target` default-fallback).
    27	2. **Fail-closed dispatch pre-gate.** BEFORE worktree prep / `_invoke_cli`: if `resolve_routed_repo` raises → abstain + `runner-blocked:repo-unresolved`, never continue to the productizer workspace.
    28	3. **Generalized fetch+clone.** A routed ticket clones its OWN repo (the `contribution_runner` self-clone pattern — NOT the wrapper's productizer `$workspace`), into a per-instance path `<workspace_root>/<repo>/<instance>-<ticket>/` (no collision; verify orphan-reaper + workspace-safety ignore/handle it). `sync_to_gerrit_develop` must learn a `repo_url`/`ref` param OR a parallel `sync_routed_repo`.
    29	4. **Gerrit review delivery.** A `GerritReviewDelivery` (parallel to `github_pr_target`): commit-msg with **Change-Id** (hook or manual trailer) + the L1 **dual co-author** trailers, then `git push <gerrit_url> HEAD:refs/for/develop` with the routed push identity. Reuses contribution_runner's clone/branch/implement; only delivery differs.
    30	5. **Project-scope the shared Gerrit gates.** Add `project:<gerrit-project>` to backpressure, file-mutex, staleness, duplicate-detection, and already-merged queries (`jira_dispatch.py:560-568,2567-2588,2735-2749`). Key by `(gerrit_project, ticket)`.
    31	6. **Tenant/context decision.** A routed (internal, non-customer) repo stays a sibling of `omnisight-self` but selects a repo-appropriate prompt context (NOT the productizer-internal corpus). Encode in RoutedRepo.
    32	7. **conference-appliance governance ACL.** Give it productizer's submit-requirements (AI+1 / human+2, ai-reviewer-bots, non-ai-reviewer, Verified) via its `refs/meta/config`, OR explicitly decide a lighter gate. Operator/admin step.
    33	
    34	## Child-story breakdown (each = independent, testable, single-CLI-session, area-coherent, revertable; safe-floor first)
    35	- **R.0 (safe floor, schema/config only, ZERO behavior change):** add `routed_repos` settings + `RoutedRepo` type + `resolve_routed_repo(labels)` with unit tests (no-label→None, resolves, unresolved→raise). No call sites wired. *area: backend, tests · tier: M*
    36	- **R.1 fail-closed dispatch pre-gate:** wire `resolve_routed_repo` BEFORE worktree prep; `repo:`-unresolved → abstain + `runner-blocked:repo-unresolved`. Normal (no-label) path bit-for-bit unchanged (regression test). *area: tooling, tests · tier: M*
    37	- **R.2 generalized fetch+clone:** routed ticket self-clones its repo into the per-instance path; `sync` learns repo_url/ref; orphan-reaper/workspace-safety verified. *area: tooling, backend, tests · tier: L*
    38	- **R.3 GerritReviewDelivery:** Change-Id + dual co-author + push refs/for to the routed gerrit_url with routed identity. *area: backend, tests · tier: L*
    39	- **R.4 project-scope shared Gerrit gates:** add gerrit-project to backpressure/file-mutex/staleness/dup/merged queries. *area: backend, tests · tier: M*
    40	- **R.5 tenant/context selection for routed repos.** *area: backend, tests · tier: M*
    41	- **R.6 conference-appliance governance ACL** (operator/admin: copy productizer submit-requirements + bot groups into refs/meta/config). *tier: X, requires:operator-approval*
    42	- **R.7 INTEGRATION GATE + end-to-end:** add `routed_repos[conference-appliance]`, re-label ONE Case 5 leaf (OP-2170) `repo:conference-appliance`+agent:auto, verify it clones conference-appliance (NOT productizer), pushes refs/for there, normal runners unaffected, change appears under conference-appliance, GitLab mirror reflects. *tier: M · the assemble-into-live gate the SOP demands.*
    43	
    44	Dependencies: R.0 blocks all; R.1→R.2→R.3 sequential (dispatch→clone→deliver); R.4/R.5 parallel after R.0; R.6 independent (operator); R.7 blocked by R.1..R.6.

docs/adr/ADR-0040-single-trunk-release-train.md:47:  - **⚠ Clarification (2026-05-22): green-as-RECORD ≠ green-as-GATE — do not conflate.** The train needs green as a **per-SHA RECORD** (RT-04a fast checks + RT-04b store) that auto-cut READS to pick a safe SHA — **non-blocking, advisory**. It does NOT need green as a **submit-time ENFORCEMENT gate** (Gerrit `Verified` SR, RT-04c) that BLOCKS every develop merge. Verified-SR enforcement is a **separate branch-protection concern, NOT a train dependency**, and it **contradicts** RT-04e's "develop merges NOT blocked on full suite / non-blocking develop flow". So RT-04c was **decoupled from RT-04e on 2026-05-22 and MUST NOT be re-linked as a train blocker.** If ever wanted, it (a) needs a live ci-bot Verified feeder wired FIRST (else enabling it LOCKS develop) and (b) must use a fast per-change check, never the full suite.
docs/adr/ADR-0040-single-trunk-release-train.md:57:2. **"Every tag prod-usable" has no test gate.** `.gitlab-ci.yml` has no test/lint stage; Gerrit `Verified` is disabled (`applicableIf=is:false`). A `v*` tag can build+sign+attest without ever proving the suite passed at that SHA — and a bad tag is a *permanent* release object. Auto-cut needs a real per-SHA green signal (pytest + FE build/typecheck + migration check + smoke/canary) before it may tag.
docs/adr/ADR-0040-single-trunk-release-train.md:61:6. **FE feature-flag is net-new work, not a flip.** Existing `backend/routers/feature_flags.py` is an operator/admin registry (leaks owner/rollout/tenant). docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:264:5. **「跨 tenant 即時切換」不是「跨 tenant 同時操作」** — Maya 在切 tenant 那一瞬間，前端應 abort 舊 tenant 的 in-flight requests / SSE / WS，避免 race（見 S-2.2）；後端在同一個 request 看到的 `X-Tenant-Id` 是切換後的、不會混淆。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:285:1. **切 tenant 必須是「軟重整」(soft reload) 而非「無感切換」** — 切 tenant 後保留現有 React state 是 footgun；Maya 在 t-acme 開了「artifact 預覽 modal」、切到 t-blossom 時 modal 必須關閉，否則 modal 內的 image src 會帶錯 tenant scope（artifact_id 對不上 t-blossom 的儲存）。實作策略：tenant context 用 `key={currentTenantId}` 包住整個 `<AppLayout>`，切 tenant 觸發 React 整 sub-tree 重 mount。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:286:2. **SSE / WS 必須在切 tenant 時關閉並重連** — 否則舊連線繼續推 t-acme 的事件、但前端已渲染為 t-blossom 的視角，UI 會錯亂。連線 close 由 React-effect cleanup 處理：`useEffect(() => { const es = new EventSource(...); return () => es.close() }, [currentTenantId])`。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:287:3. **`POST /auth/active-tenant` 是 best-effort 的書籤 / audit 寫入** — 不是 RBAC gate（gate 由 middleware + memberships 表做）。後端就算 5xx 失敗、前端切 tenant 仍生效（headers 已換）；只是失去 audit 與「下次登入預設」的便利。S-2 endpoint 設計強調 idempotent、可重試、不阻塞 UI。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:288:4. **「切到自己沒 membership 的 tenant」必須在前端就擋掉** — switcher 的選項本來就只列 `GET /auth/tenants` 回傳的合法 tenant；但 URL deep-link（如 `/?tenant=t-stranger`）需要 frontend reject + 後端 middleware 第二道防線（403 + 引導回主 tenant）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:289:5. **「無 membership 切 tenant」用 403 而非 404** — 避免 tenant id enumeration；403 回應只說 "Tenant not accessible"、不說 "Tenant t-stranger does not exist vs you don't have access"。S-1.3 設計的「fingerprint 不洩漏」原則延伸到這。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:290:6. **switcher 必須區分 `enabled=false` tenant** — Plan 過期 / 退訂的 tenant 在 switcher 灰掉但仍可選（讓 owner 進去做 last-resort 動作如 export data），但選中後 banner 提示「tenant disabled、唯讀」（呼應 S-1.8 邊界場景）。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:330:4. **POST `/auth/active-tenant` 是 audit + 更新 session 欄位、不是 RBAC gate** — 看到「Maya 在 14:22 切到 t-acme」純粹用於 forensic 與 UX bookmark；middleware 不依賴它做任何判斷（避免 audit 寫入失敗導致 user 被卡住）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:331:5. **`is_super_admin` 旗標 + step-up MFA 是雙保險** — `users.is_super_admin=true` + 想對非自己主 tenant 做事必須先打 `POST /auth/impersonation-token { tenant_id, mfa_code }`，回傳一張 5 分鐘短期 token 寫進 cookie；該 cookie 期間任意 tenant 切換不需重打 MFA。Y3 / Y9 落地。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:371:### S-2.5 Audit 防混淆 — Cross-tenant Audit Hygiene
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:373:當同一個 user 跨 N tenant 操作時，audit 鏈最容易出 cross-contamination bug。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:376:- `audit_events.tenant_id` 永遠是「事件發生在哪個 tenant 的 scope」、不是 actor 的主 tenant。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:377:- `audit_events.actor_user_id` 是 user.id（跨 tenant 唯一）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:384:| `GET /api/v1/audit?actor_user_id=maya` (Maya 自己) | 跨 4 個 tenant 的所有事件，但 UI 用 tab 切 tenant、不混合時間軸 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:385:| `GET /api/v1/audit?tenant_id=t-acme&actor_user_id=maya`（t-acme owner Alice） | t-acme 內 Maya 的事件 — Alice 看得到（她是 owner） |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:386:| `GET /api/v1/audit?tenant_id=t-cobalt&actor_user_id=maya`（t-acme owner Alice） | 403 — Alice 不是 t-cobalt 的 owner，看不到別人的 audit |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:387:| `GET /api/v1/audit?actor_user_id=maya`（t-cobalt 某 viewer） | 只看到 `tenant_id=t-cobalt AND actor_user_id=maya` 的事件（即 viewer 自我中心過濾不允許跨 tenant） |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:390:1. **Audit chain 嚴格 per-tenant 隔離** — t-acme 的 chain head hash 與 t-cobalt 的 chain head hash 互不相關；Maya 在 t-acme 跑了 100 個事件、不影響 t-cobalt chain。R5（audit chain）落地時的 PG advisory lock 已 per-tenant 切，S-2 不弱化。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:391:2. **「Maya 個人時間軸」是 UI 端 fan-out 查詢、不是新表** — 不要為「跨 tenant 個人 audit」單獨建 `user_audit_global` 之類的表；UI 並列 N 個 `tenant_id=X` 的查詢結果即可（避免雙寫 / 一致性 bug）。權限上：每個 query 各自走 RBAC 過濾，所以「我看得到的」自然是合法子集。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:392:3. **Audit row 的 `subject` payload 不能順手把 `actor_tenant_id` 寫成 actor 的主 tenant** — 一個常見 footgun 是 `audit.write({ actor: user.id, actor_tenant: user.tenant_id, ... })`，但 user.tenant_id 是主 tenant 快取、不是當下 active tenant。Y9 落地時把 `actor_tenant` 欄位整個移除（事件 `tenant_id` 已存）、並在 audit row schema 標記 actor 是 user.id（純 user 維度，不混 tenant 維度）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:393:4. **「跨 tenant」action 在 audit 上要 surface 為兩條相關事件** — 例如 Pat（super-admin）對 t-acme 啟用 plan 升級：(a) 寫一條 `tenant.plan_changed` 進 t-acme 的 chain，(b) 同時寫一條 `platform.tenant_admin_action` 進 platform-internal audit（以 `tenant_id=NULL` 或 `tenant_id="_platform_"` 表達）。這條鏡像由 Y9 處理。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:424:1. **`is_primary` 約束是 partial unique index、不是 trigger** — `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON user_tenant_memberships (user_id) WHERE is_primary = true`，PG 原生語法、寫入時 atomic、不需 row-level trigger 維護。Maya 換主 tenant 時走「先 set false、再 set true」的兩步交易（同 transaction 內）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:425:2. **`is_super_admin` 與 `users.role='admin'` 不重複** — `is_super_admin` 是平台級（跨 tenant 維運）；`users.role='admin'` / `user_tenant_memberships.role='admin'` 是 tenant 內角色（admin within scope）。Y1 migration 把現有 `users.role='admin'` 不自動升為 `is_super_admin`、需要 operator 在 bootstrap wizard 顯式勾選「平台 super-admin = ✅」。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:426:3. **`sessions.active_tenant_id` 與 `users.last_active_tenant_id` 不同** — 前者是當前 session 的 active scope（每次 `POST /auth/active-tenant` 更新）；後者是「下次新登入時的預設」（只在 logout / new login 時讀）。兩欄分開避免「Maya 登一個 session 切到 t-acme、開另一 browser 登第二 session 預設仍是 t-bridge-msp」這種反直覺行為。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:427:4. **既有 `users.tenant_id` 不可移除（兩階段）** — Y1 階段並存（雙寫 + 雙讀、`user_tenant_memberships` 是權威）；Y10 階段才能移除欄位（要等所有 read sites 改完）。S-2 不負責收尾（屬 [S-9 遺留相容](#s-9-遺留相容)）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:428:5. **`pending_invite` 狀態 row** — Maya 接到 t-cobalt 的邀請但尚未接受時，先寫 `user_tenant_memberships(maya, t-cobalt, viewer, status='pending_invite')`，accept 後改 `active`。狀態為 `pending_invite` 的 row 不出現在 `GET /auth/tenants`（S-2.2 switcher 只列 `status='active'`）；屬 Y3 範圍。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:484:1. **「Maya 切 tenant 時的 in-flight HTTP request 怎麼處理？」** — abort 是激進、有些 idempotent GET 可以放它跑完；但對 mutation 必須 abort。落地時是否 case-by-case 還是一律 abort？目前傾向「全 abort + UI 顯示 loading 重新拉」、Y8 落實。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:488:5. **「impersonation token 期間切換多 tenant」** — Pat 拿到 5 分鐘 step-up token、能不能在這 5 分鐘內切多個 tenant、每個都用此 token？目前傾向 token 綁 `impersonation_target_tenant` 單一 tenant、切到第二個要重新 step-up；但 Y9 forensic 場景可能需要 Pat 連跳 5 個 tenant — 等使用情境驗證後決定。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:523:> tenant A（**host**）想把自己某個 project 開放給 tenant B 的 user（**guest**）看（唯讀）或讓他評論（read-comment），但 guest 不應該看到 host 的其他 project / 其他 secret / 其他 audit；guest 在 host 的視角是「**在自己的 tenant 裡看到一個被 mount 進來的外部 project**」、不是「臨時切到 host tenant」。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:525:> **與 S-1 / S-2 的差異邊界**：S-1 是「同 tenant 多 user」、S-2 是「同 user 多 tenant 但 tenant 之間互不交集」、S-3 是首次出現「**資料跨 tenant 邊界流動**」的情境 — host 的某個 project row 在 guest tenant 的 sidebar 出現、host 的 audit 事件在 guest 視角部分可見、host 的 LLM 預算可能因 guest 的瀏覽 / 評論而消耗。S-1 / S-2 的所有 invariant 仍持續成立（guest 看 host 的 project ≠ guest 變成 host tenant 的 member）；S-3 在這之上加一條新的權威表 `project_shares` 與 guest 視角的 fence 規則。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:541:1. **「Guest」不是 tenant 內角色、是 share 邊界 metadata** — guest 角色的 user 仍然完全屬於 guest tenant（`user_tenant_memberships(cody, t-cobalt, member, active)`）、不在 host tenant 建任何 row；host 視角看到的「guest」是透過 `project_shares` 反查得來。這保證撤銷 share 時 guest user 在 host 端立刻消失（不需要刪 user / membership / role row 三處）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:542:2. **Share 授權需「雙簽」** — host 端的 project share 必須同時有：(a) **project-level owner 同意**（Carol 是 firmware-ipcam owner）+ (b) **tenant-level owner / admin 同意**（Alice / Bob）。理由：project owner 知道內容該不該給外部看（業務判斷）、tenant owner 知道對方 tenant 是否可信（合規 / 法務判斷）；單一一方都不夠安全。Y4 endpoint `POST /.../projects/{pid}/shares` 必須在 backend 強制這個 quorum（不能只信任 frontend）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:543:3. **Guest role 的最大值是 `commenter`（不能是 contributor / owner）** — 跨 tenant 的 RBAC ceiling 設在 `commenter`、即使 host 想開放更多也不允許。理由：contributor 能 trigger workflow_run（要燒 host LLM quota）、能改 SOP（影響 host 內部其他 user），這兩個都不該由跨 tenant 帳號控制；想真正讓對方 contribute、就應該邀請對方為 host tenant 的 member（走 S-2 invite 流），而非 guest。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:545:5. **Guest 在 host 端 audit 是 first-class actor** — `audit_log.actor` 一直記成 `cody@cobalt.com`（不是匿名化、不是 `guest@*`），但**多加一欄** `actor_external_tenant_id='t-cobalt'`，讓 host 端的 audit 篩選時能 surface 「是哪個外部 tenant 的人做的」、避免事後追責失準。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:584:1. **Guest 路徑與 member 路徑完全不交叉** — `resolve_role` 先判斷「user 是不是這個 tenant 的 member」、是就走 S-1 / S-2；否則才看 share。一個 user **不可能同時是 host tenant 的 member 又是 guest**（若 Cody 哪天加入 acme 為 member，share 路徑就被 short-circuit、走 member 路徑，避免雙重路徑導致 RBAC 推導歧義）。Y2 / Y5 dependency 強制這個排他性。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:585:2. **Share 是 tenant-to-project 的 grant、不是 user-to-project 的 grant** — `project_shares.guest_tenant_id` 是 `t-cobalt`、不是 `cody@cobalt.com`。理由：(a) host 端不需要知道 guest tenant 內哪些 user 該 access，由 guest tenant 自己 RBAC 決定；(b) guest user 異動（離職 / 加入）不需要 host 端配合改 share；(c) audit 上仍能透過 `actor_user_id` 知道是 guest tenant 內哪個 user 真正動作。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:586:3. **Guest 端可「再下調」role、不能「再上調」** — host 設 share role=`commenter`，guest tenant 內：(a) 預設所有 active member 都繼承為 commenter；(b) guest tenant 的 admin 可在 cobalt UI 設「只有 cody / cher 能進這個 share」（fence 縮小）；(c) 但 guest tenant 不能把 share role 升為 contributor（即使 host 同意也不行 — 因為 guest 的角色是跨 tenant ceiling）。Y4 endpoint 用 `_cap_role(share_role, guest_member_role_for_this_share)` 取 min。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:587:4. **`fetch_active_share` 必查 `expires_at`** — 不能依賴 cron 撤銷過期 share；middleware 每 request 檢查（避免 cron 延遲導致過期 share 仍被使用）。配 LRU cache（key=(project_id, guest_tenant_id)，TTL 30s + invalidation hook on share mutation）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:588:5. **`resolve_role` 對 share 路徑回傳 `None` 時必須 403、不能 fallthrough 到 viewer** — 這個 fence 是安全邊界，不存在「降級為 viewer 是友善 default」的設計空間；任何 fallthrough 都是 cross-tenant leak。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:594:**非對稱性的根源**：host 端要看到「Cody 來看了我的 artifact」（forensic / 客戶服務），guest tenant 端要看到「我的 user Cody 上週外出存取了 acme 的 4 個 artifact」（離職前審查 / 計費對帳）。但兩端不能完整看到對方鏈的全部 row（否則就是 leak）。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:606:2. **兩條鏈的 row 內容**「**對應但非鏡像**」 — host 鏈內容詳細（包含 artifact id、comment 內文）、guest 鏈內容是「sanitized 摘要」（只到 kind 層、不到 instance 層）。理由：guest tenant 的 audit 不該成為「窺探 host 內部命名空間」的後門。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:607:3. **`actor` 在兩條鏈都是 `cody@cobalt.com`** — 不在 host 鏈匿名化為 `guest_001@t-cobalt`（會讓 forensic 查無此人 / 客訴對接時對不到人）；但 host 鏈額外加 `actor_external_tenant_id` 欄位（S-3.1 設計斷言 5）讓 host 端 audit 篩選器能「我只想看 cobalt 的人做了什麼」一鍵分組。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:608:4. **`share_id` 是兩條鏈的 join key** — forensic 場景 (e.g. cobalt 與 acme 對帳「上個月 Cody 看了多少次」) 由 reviewer 用 `share_id` 在兩 tenant audit 各自查、比對 row count 一致 — 不靠任何「跨 tenant audit join API」（那會打破 audit chain 的 per-tenant 隔離 invariant）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:610:6. **`audit.guest_fence_narrowed` 不外寫到 host** — guest tenant 內部的 RBAC 細節（cobalt 把 cody 從 share 移除、改派 daria）是 cobalt 的內部紀律、host 不該觸及；host 視角只看到「依然有人來自 cobalt」即可。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:614:S-3 引入「跨 tenant 邊界資料流動」、最危險的 leak 路徑是 secret。完整 fence 設計：
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:618:| Cody（guest commenter）想 `GET /api/v1/tenants/t-acme/secrets` | 403 — guest role 從 `commenter` 推導對 secret 端的 capability=`null` | secret 端從來只開給 host tenant 內部 user（S-1.3 設計斷言 1-3）；guest role ceiling 在 `commenter`、與 secret read 完全不交集 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:620:| Cody 在 comment 內 paste `sk-xxxx`（手動社交工程） | host 端 audit row `actor=cody, content="sk-xxxx"` 完整保留（自動 redact 反而失證據鏈完整性）；但 host 端 UI 顯示 comment 時自動 mask（`sk-***xxxx`）+ 顯示 banner「Comment contains potential secret pattern」+ host 端 owner 可手動申請刪除 row | 跨 tenant 來的 comment 是 untrusted input、host 端要假設可能含惡意 / 釣魚內容；但 audit 完整性高於 UI 美觀 |

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:626:1. **「跨 tenant 看到的」 ≤「host viewer 看到的」** — 任何 host 內部 viewer（如 Eve）看不到的資訊（secret fingerprint、LLM cost、internal audit、其他 project 名）guest 也看不到。這是 RBAC ceiling 的延伸：guest commenter 對「secret-derived」欄位的能見度 ≤ host viewer = `null`。Y5 implementation 要把 `is_guest_actor` flag 帶進每個 RBAC 檢查 dependency、預設黑名單模式。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:782:> **與 S-1 / S-2 / S-3 的差異邊界**：S-1 / S-2 / S-3 處理的是「user × tenant」的 RBAC 邊界；S-4 是首次出現「**tenant 內部資源垂直切分**」的情境 — 同一 tenant 內的所有 user 都還是同一個 RBAC 對象（沿用 S-1 / S-2 的 membership 模型不變），但「project / artifact / quota / secret / on-call」這層**資源繼承 / override 階層**多了一個中介層 `product_line`（`tenants → product_lines → projects → workflow_runs / artifacts`）。S-4 不引入新的 user 角色、不修改 share 模型；它純粹是把「tenant」一層的「LLM 預算 / git 整合 / on-call routing / SOP / skill pack」四類設定**再切片一次**，讓單一 tenant 也能 model 真實多產品線運營的隔離度。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:798:1. **`product_line` 不是 user 的角色屬性、是 user 在某 tenant 內 membership 的「scope filter」** — Pam 在 `t-acme` 仍然只有一個 `user_tenant_memberships` row（role=member），`product_line` 訪問權限走另一張表 `product_line_members(product_line_id, user_id, role)`。理由：(a) 同一 user 加入新 product line 不需要動 tenant membership row；(b) tenant role（owner/admin）天然繼承所有 product line 權限、無需在 product_line_members 重複寫 row；(c) S-1 既有 RBAC 階層不破壞。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:799:2. **Tenant owner / admin 預設訪問所有 product line** — Alice / Bob 不需要在 `product_line_members` 各 line 寫 row；middleware fallback「tenant role ≥ admin → 任意 product_line OK」。`product_line_members` row 的存在意義是「member 級 user 被授權進入特定 line」。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:800:3. **Product-line owner 不是新 RBAC 階層、是 product_line_members.role 的一個值** — `product_line_members.role ∈ ('owner','contributor','viewer')`、與 `project_members.role` 同 vocabulary；想真正在 IPCam line 內動 budget / on-call，必須是 `product_line_members(pam, pl-ipcam, role='owner')` + tenant role ≥ member。Y4 endpoint 在改 line-level 設定時 require `(tenant_role ≥ admin) OR (product_line_role == 'owner')`。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:846:4. **雙層 atomic decrement 必同 transaction** — Race scenario：IPCam 與 Doorbell 同時各觸發 5M tokens call、tenant ceiling 剩 8M。若雙寫不同 transaction，可能兩邊 line counter 各 -5M 成功（line 各還剩 45M / 30M）但 tenant counter 變成 -2M（超 ceiling）。`atomic_decrement_both` 必走 PG `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` 兩 row 一次鎖 + 任一不足則整批 rollback。Y6 落地時 SOP Step 1 必寫「合格答案 #2 — 透過 PG 序列化」釋因。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:1684:1. **Bare clone per project，所有 worktree 共用 object store** — 4 個 long-lived branch + N 個 agent task worktree 共用同一 `_bare/objects/`，磁碟省 4×~ + git fetch 只下載一次；bare clone 本身是 idempotent（雙重檢查 + advisory lock）每 worker 從相同 source 推導出相同路徑（合格答案 #1）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:1685:2. **PG advisory lock keyed (project_id, branch)** — 取代既有「靠 agent_id 唯一性 + 無鎖」模型；同 project 同 branch 兩個 in-flight 操作（如 worktree add 與 branch fetch）必序列化；不同 branch / 不同 project 完全 parallel。Lock key namespace 用 hash(("branch_worktree", project_id, branch)) 對應 PG 64-bit advisory lock id；txn level 鎖（自動釋放）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:1686:3. **Long-lived branch worktree 與 agent task worktree 兩條獨立 path** — `provision_branch_worktree` / `provision_agent_task_worktree` 分兩 function、不共用 `_workspaces` registry（branch worktree 不註冊到 `_workspaces` dict、後者只追蹤 ephemeral agent task）；理由：lifecycle 不同（前者跟 branch、後者跟 task）、cleanup policy 不同、registry 共用會混淆 GC 範圍。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:1688:5. **External clone path（既有 `git clone "{source}" "{ws_path}"`）退役**（`backend/workspace.py:193-197`） — 改一律走「先 bare clone 一份 → worktree add」；理由：既有路徑每 task fresh clone 浪費頻寬 + 每 task 各自 push 認證、改 bare clone 後 4 branch + N task 共用一次 fetch 的 object pack。external repo 的 auth env（`backend/git_auth.py`）只在 bare clone 時用一次。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:1689:6. **Force-push detection + recovery** — `provision_branch_worktree` 的 fetch 步驟若回 `non-fast-forward` 警告（即 upstream 被 force-push）、worktree 內 working tree 標 stale、SSE 推 project owner notification + audit 寫 `branch.upstream_force_pushed(branch=...)` 不自動 reset；強制 reset 走人類動作 `POST /projects/{id}/branches/{branch}/reset-to-upstream` + step-up MFA（防意外 lose 本地 commit）。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2066:4. **`audit_log` 永遠不刪、即使 terminated** — terminated 後 90d billing-dispute window 結束後 disk artifact 被 unlink、但 audit_log row 永久保留；理由：合規（SOC2 / ISO27001 要求 audit 留 ≥ 7 年）、跨 tenant forensic（cobalt 退訂後 acme 想查「cobalt 在 share 期間做了什麼」必須能查）、internal forensic（金錢糾紛調查）。disk 占用估算：audit_log row 每 ~500 bytes、Cobalt 6 個月用量 ≤ 10MB、永久保留可接受。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2068:6. **suspended 不釋放 disk quota** — 暫停期間若 quota 釋放、後續 reactivate 時 disk 已被別人占用（disk LRU GC 跨 tenant 競爭）；suspended 凍結保留是 reactivate 友善設計。但 LLM cap 凍結（不釋放也不允許用）— 反正暫停期 LLM 0 用量、是否釋放沒差。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2069:7. **wind_down 期間 cross-tenant share 變 frozen 而非 revoked** — 立即 revoke 會讓 guest 還沒下載完的 artifact 失效（合規舉證材料）、走 frozen 讓 guest 在 export window 內下載完後再 revoke；wind_down_deadline + share.host_lifecycle_changed event 是 guest tenant 端的單一事實來源、Cher 走 SSE 看到 banner 主動下載。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2070:8. **platform super-admin 強制下架（合規事件 / 安全事件）skip suspended 直入 wind_down** — 例：Cobalt 被舉報嚴重違規平台政策、Pat 評估後強制下架、跳 suspended 直 wind_down + reason='platform_enforcement'；走 platform-side 雙簽 + step-up MFA + email tenant owner notice。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2168:3. **suspended 與 terminated 的 disk 行為不同** — suspended 期間 disk 仍 quota 計（tenant 還在）；terminated 後 disk view 移除（tenant 從統計切出）；理由：suspended 是可逆、disk row 留著等補繳；terminated 不可逆、disk view 移除避免 platform-wide quota 統計被殭屍 tenant 占用。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2170:5. **freeze 期間 LLM call 必 402 而非 429** — 402 是「需要付費 / 計費資源不足」HTTP 標準、429 是「請求頻率超限」；suspended / wind_down 是計費狀態凍結、應回 402 + clear 訊息「您的 tenant 已暫停、請聯繫管理員恢復」；429 用於正常 tenant 的 quota 用盡。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2171:6. **quota 變更必雙寫 audit + SSE event** — `quota_changed(scope=user|tenant|project, action=release|freeze|unfreeze, before=X, after=Y, reason=...)` 是 first-class audit event；SSE 推 dashboard 即時 update、不靠 polling 看到 quota 變化。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2327:1. **「ownership 接手人 unavailable 時的 fallback chain」** — S-7.2 Step 3.d 寫「fallback 到執行 offboarding 的 admin」、但若該 admin 同時離職（雙離職 race）？目前傾向「fallback chain：原 owner → 接手人指派 → 執行 admin → tenant owner → platform super-admin」、5 層；但雙人 race 的 transaction 鎖定策略需在 Y4 落地時定（advisory lock keyed by (entity_type, entity_id)）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2328:2. **「audit 永久保留 vs 7-year compliance default」** — S-7.5 L1 設計為「永久保留」、但有些行業（金融）要 7 年強制保留 + 7 年後可選刪除；OmniSight 是否該支援「configurable retention 7 / 永久 / 自訂」？目前傾向「永久 default、operator 顯式覆寫成 7 年才刪」、避免 default 隱式刪除誤判；但 Y10 落地時可能需 per-tenant configurable。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2330:4. **「user 離職 28d undo grace 是否該 per-user / per-tenant 可配」** — 28d 是 OmniSight 預設、但合規嚴的 tenant 可能想 14d（縮短 attack surface）、HR 流程慢的可能想 60d（趕不上 batch processing）；目前傾向「tenant-level setting 可配 14 ～ 90d、預設 28d、超出範圍 reject」；但 RBAC 誰能改該設定（owner only？）需 Y3 / Y4 落地時定。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2331:5. **「terminated tenant 是否該允許『新建 tenant + import audit chain pointer』復活路徑」** — Cobalt terminated 後 Alice 想用同 email / 同 plan 開新 tenant、新 tenant 是否該 inherit cobalt 的 audit chain 為「歷史記錄」？目前傾向「不 inherit、新 tenant 全新 chain、舊 tenant audit 走 historical-export 拿（呼應 S-7.9 row 6）」、避免 chain 混淆 + 合規上「Cobalt v1 與 Cobalt v2 是兩個法律實體」；但實作需 Y4 / Y10 落地時最終決議。

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2366:> 單 project 在某時段打爆 tenant 的 LLM token 月預算（或 tenant 在某時段打爆 host 的 CPU / memory 並發預算）→ 其他 project / 其他 tenant 是否會被餓死？本章鎖定 OmniSight 的「公平分配 vs hard isolation vs 動態降級」三選一決策、並把既有 `tenant_aimd` + `host_metrics.get_culprit_tenant` + `circuit_breaker` + `RedisLimiter` + `SharedCounter` 五件零組件對齊成 **DRF (Dominant Resource Fairness) 三層 quota engine** 的單一事實來源；為 Y6（quota engine 落地）/ Y8（dashboard 火災現場視覺化）/ Y9（hotspot audit + SSE）/ Y10（per-tenant fairness policy 設定）的設計提供可引用骨架。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2370:S-8 的 actor 與 victim 不再是「user 對 user」（S-1 ～ S-7），而是「資源燒手 vs 被餓死的鄰居」。承接 Acme（IPCam Pam / Doorbell Doris / Intercom Ian 三線、共 100M tokens / 30d 預算 — S-4.2 設計）+ Cobalt（cross-tenant guest 受影響者 — S-3）+ Bridge MSP（Maya 跨 tenant 服務的 N:N 視角 — S-2）已建構樣本：
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2377:| **Cher（cobalt guest、跨 tenant 無辜鄰居）** | 被餓死（cross-tenant share 級別） | Cobalt guest 對 acme 某 share 的 LLM-driven query 被 acme 整 tenant 的 quota 撞牆波及 | 走「caller pays」原路 — share 用 cobalt 自己 LLM cap、acme 撞牆與 Cher 無關 | 不能要求 acme 釋放 cap 給 share；不能要求 host 提供 fallback LLM provider |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2378:| **Pat（platform super-admin、host 級別仲裁者）** | 仲裁者（host CPU / memory 撞牆） | 多 tenant 同時 LLM 大批量撞 host 95% CPU、tenant_aimd plan_derate 進 FLAT path | 看 dashboard 找 culprit、必要時 PATCH 該 tenant 的 emergency_pause + 通知 owner | 不能對 culprit tenant 直接 disable（屬安全事件、不是熱點問題）；不能跨 tenant 強制 budget 重分配 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2379:| **Bob（acme tenant admin、tenant 級別仲裁者）** | 仲裁者（tenant 內 line 撞 ceiling） | IPCam line 50M 燒完、Bob 是否要從 Doorbell 借 5M？ | 走 `POST /tenants/{id}/budgets/rebalance` 顯式重分配（雙簽 + audit）；查 dashboard 對 culprit project 排序 | 不能 silent 自動重分配（S-4.2 設計斷言 2、line 隔離是 invariant、人類顯式動作才能破） |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2382:1. **「資源燒手」與「被餓死」是同一機制的兩端、不該獨立設計** — DRF 引擎判斷誰是 culprit + 誰要被 throttle 是同一輪 control cycle 的兩端決策；既有 `tenant_aimd.plan_derate()` (`backend/tenant_aimd.py:112-180`) 已是這個雙端模型的雛形（CULPRIT / FLAT / RECOVER / HOLD 四 reason）、S-8 只擴維（host CPU → token budget + concurrent request）不重設計。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2383:2. **公平分配的「層級」與資源 scope 嚴格對齊** — host CPU / memory 撞牆 → host 級 DRF（platform Pat 仲裁、跨 tenant 公平）；tenant LLM ceiling 撞牆 → tenant 級 DRF（admin Bob 仲裁、tenant 內 line / project 公平）；line LLM cap 撞牆 → line 級 DRF（line owner 仲裁、line 內 project 公平）。**3 個層級各自獨立 cycle、不互相替代**。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2384:3. **floor multiplier 0.1 是 OmniSight 已釘的「不餓死保證」** — `tenant_aimd.AimdConfig.min_multiplier=0.1` (`backend/tenant_aimd.py:48`) 明示「a tenant can never be starved to death」；S-8 把這個 invariant 提升為 first-class 設計斷言、應用到 token budget / concurrent request 兩個新增 quota 維度（不只 CPU）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2385:4. **cross-tenant 「caller pays」是 fairness 計算的天然斷點** — Cher 對 acme share 的 LLM call 由 cobalt 付（S-3.4 設計斷言 2）、所以 acme tenant 撞牆與 Cher 無關（acme 不該因「擔心 Cher 燒爆」而限制 share）；fairness 計算是「按付費 tenant scope」累計、跨 tenant 不入 acme tenant 公平池。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2395:| **host CPU / memory hotspot** | `host_metrics.get_culprit_tenant()` (`backend/host_metrics.py:805-845`) — 1 outlier 比 next 高 ≥ 150% margin、絕對值 ≥ 80% CPU | `tenant_aimd.plan_derate()` 把 culprit multiplier × 0.5、floor 0.1；無 culprit + host hot 走 FLAT path 全降 | 把 multiplier 也應用到 LLM token rate（不只 sandbox concurrency）；DerateReason 加 `HOTSPOT_TOKEN`、與既有 `CULPRIT/FLAT` 並排 | platform Pat（觀察）+ AIMD cycle（自動）|
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2396:| **tenant LLM token ceiling 撞牆**（30d window）| 不存在 — 目前 `backend/llm_secrets.py` + `backend/llm_balance.py` 只讀 provider 側 balance、沒 per-tenant 月度 token 計數器 | 不存在 — 撞牆後 provider 回 429、`agents/llm.py:117-165` 解析 ratelimit header 但無 enforcement，整 tenant 一起 429 | Y6 新增 `llm_token_meter`（SharedCounter `omnisight:shared:counter:llm_tokens:{tenant_id}:30d` + `_line:{line_id}:30d` + `_project:{project_id}:30d`）+ DRF 切片：line ceiling 撞牆 → line 內 project 按 weighted fair-share 重排 | tenant admin Bob（仲裁）+ line owner Pam（觀察）|

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2400:1. **三類訊號各自有獨立 SSE event type、不合併** — `host.hotspot_changed` / `tenant.token_ceiling_hit` / `tenant.slot_starved` 是三個獨立 SSE event（與 S-7.3 設計斷言類似的多 stage 模式）；frontend 可分別訂閱 dashboard 不同 panel；audit_log.action 也是三個獨立 enum 值、forensic 可分別查。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2403:4. **既有 `RedisLimiter` 是 HTTP 請求級不是 LLM-token 級** — `backend/rate_limit.py:150-226` Lua-atomic token bucket 是 per-IP / per-user / per-tenant 的「請求頻率」限制、與 LLM token 計費無關；**不能把 plan_quotas 直接當 LLM ceiling**（PLAN_QUOTAS 的 600 / 60s 是 request rate、不是 30d token 預算）；S-8 必另起 `llm_token_meter` 模組、不重用 RedisLimiter 的桶。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2404:5. **circuit_breaker.is_open 是「provider 撞牆」不是 OmniSight 內部 fairness** — `backend/circuit_breaker.py:217-235` 對 (tenant_id, provider, fingerprint) 三元 tuple 開路 300s、其本質是「provider 端 429 後給 5 min 冷卻」；S-8 的 fairness 是 OmniSight 內部 quota 不是 provider 限制（兩者可同時觸發、行為獨立）；UI banner 必區分「您的 LLM provider 暫時 unavailable（circuit breaker）」vs「您的 tenant 月度預算用盡（token meter）」。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2405:6. **MODE_MULTIPLIER 是「人類運維選擇」不是 fairness 信號** — `backend/adaptive_budget.py:120-148` 中 turbo=1.0 / full_auto=0.7 / supervised=0.4 / manual=0.15 是 OperationMode 的人類選擇（user 在 dashboard 切 mode）、不是 culprit 反應；S-8 fairness multiplier 與 MODE_MULTIPLIER 是兩個獨立乘數、final effective slot = `MODE_MULTIPLIER × tenant_aimd_multiplier × line_drf_share`。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2416:| **d. DRF (Dominant Resource Fairness)** | 多資源（token / slot / disk）按各 tenant / project 的「dominant resource share」動態平衡 | 公平 + 高利用率 + 多資源同框架 | 心智成本高、需 tooling 解釋；本章為解這個成本而寫 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2421:2. **既有零組件已 DRF-friendly** — `tenant_aimd.plan_derate()` 已實作了「culprit 偵測 + multiplier」這對 DRF 來說是 second-half 邏輯；OmniSight 缺的是 first-half（per-tenant resource demand 統計、dominant axis 選擇），用 SharedCounter 三維（token / slot / cpu）即可補。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2423:4. **caller pays 是 DRF 的天然 scope 邊界** — DRF 算「同 tenant 內」公平；cross-tenant share 走 caller pays（S-3.4 設計斷言 2）、自然不入 fairness 池；不需要寫額外 cross-tenant 公平邏輯。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2425:**DRF 三層 cycle 偽碼**（host / tenant / line 三層各自跑、不互相替代）：
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2431:    """單一 entity (tenant / line / project) 的 demand vector。"""
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2439:    token_cap: int           # tenant_quota / line_budget / project_cap (S-4.2/S-5.2)
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2441:    cpu_cap_pct: float       # 100% (host) / per-tenant CPU budget (M4 future)
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2473:1. **DRF 是 OmniSight 已部分實作的事實答案、不是新概念引入** — 既有 `tenant_aimd` 是 DRF 的 second-half；S-8 設計把這個事實寫成 first-class、避免後續 reviewer 誤把 DRF 當作 greenfield 重設計；Y6 落地是「補 first-half + 串連既有 second-half」、不是新建一個 fairness 引擎。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2474:2. **dominant axis 用「per-entity max share」而非全域 max share** — Ghodsi DRF 原文（NSDI'11）的設計：每 entity 自己選 dominant axis（即 entity 自己最受限的資源）；OmniSight 三軸（token / slot / cpu）每 tenant / line / project 自選、不全域統一。理由：Pam 的 dominant 可能是 token（fuzzing batch 燒 token）、Doris 的 dominant 可能是 slot（量產 push commit 多 sandbox）、Sam 的 dominant 可能是 cpu（本地 compile heavy）；強迫單一全域 axis 會讓 fairness 退化成「按該軸分」、其他軸不公平。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2475:3. **三層 cycle 各自獨立 + 結果是乘數疊乘** — final_slot_multiplier(project) = `host_aimd_multiplier(tenant)` × `tenant_drf_multiplier(line)` × `line_drf_multiplier(project)`；三層各自跑、各層 floor 0.1；最壞情況 0.1³ = 0.1% baseline 但實際永遠不會三層同時 floor（host 撞牆 ≠ tenant 撞牆 ≠ line 撞牆）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2476:4. **DRF cycle 頻率是 30s（與 tenant_aimd 既有 cycle 對齊）** — `backend/adaptive_budget.py:84-108` AIMD 每 30s 一輪；S-8 三層 DRF 也走 30s（同 cycle 共讀 `host_metrics.get_all_tenant_usage()` 結果）；不引入新 cron 頻率減少維運負擔。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2477:5. **SharedCounter / SharedKV 是唯一狀態載體、`drf_engine` 是 stateless 函數** — 與 `tenant_aimd` 既有設計一致（plan_derate 是 pure function、state 在 `_state` dict）；S-8 升級時 `_state` 改 SharedKV("drf_state") 跨 worker 共享、計算函數仍 pure。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2478:6. **floor 0.1 是「保證 IP / 不餓死」、不是「fair share lower bound」** — 0.1 multiplier 不代表 0.1 dominant share、是 baseline budget 的 10%（與 `tenant_aimd.AimdConfig` 一致）；想升 0.05 floor 需 follow-up Y10 task（`min_multiplier` 配置化）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2487:| **Reject**（HTTP 4xx / 5xx 立刻退） | 立刻回 429（rate limit）/ 402（quota exhausted）/ 503（服務忙）；client 自己決定是否重試 | 失敗、需要重試 | 月度 token 0 剩 / tenant suspended（S-7.3）/ host 撞牆且 floor=0.1 也撐不住 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2489:**OmniSight 兩條路的具體 dispatch 表**：
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2493:| `tenant token_used_30d / token_cap < 1.0`（cap 還剩）+ DRF multiplier × 0.5 | Throttle | 200（內部排隊） | 等 — server 側 latency 自然拉高 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2494:| `tenant token_used_30d / token_cap >= 1.0`（cap 用盡） | Reject | 402（quota exhausted） | 升 plan / 等下個 30d window |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2495:| `line token_used_30d / line_cap >= 1.0` 但 tenant 還剩 | Reject | 402（line quota exhausted） | 顯示「IPCam line 額度用盡、其他 line 仍可」+ 顯式跨 line rebalance 路徑（Bob / owner 雙簽） |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2496:| `tenant_aimd multiplier == 0.1` floor + 還在燒 | Throttle（等下一輪 cycle） | 200（佇列、長 latency） | 等 30s ～ 5min；UI banner「您的 tenant 是當前 culprit」 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2497:| `circuit_breaker.is_open(tenant, provider, fp)` | Reject | 503（provider unavailable） | 等 5min cooldown + 切 fallback provider（若有 chain） |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2498:| `tenant.lifecycle_stage IN ('suspended','wind_down')` | Reject | 402（tenant frozen, S-7.3） | 走 S-7 reactivate / wind_down / terminate 流程 |
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2499:| `tenant.lifecycle_stage = 'terminated'` | Reject | 403（tenant terminated, S-7.3） | 不可恢復 |

docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2775:1. **加性是不可協商的紅線** — 對應 TODO.md L1612「最小驚訝原則：既有 `t-default` tenant 下的所有資料不可因為 Y 的架構變更而遺失或重新路由 — migration 必須是加性的，shard 成多 tenant 是 operator 主動動作」；S-9 把這條 invariant 從 TODO 文字延伸到「Y1 ～ Y8 任何 PR 不允許 ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN / RENAME COLUMN / 改 DEFAULT / 改 enum value 在 t-default 層」具體可驗收條件（Y1 reviewer 對 alembic migration 必跑 `--sql` dry-run grep `DROP|RENAME|ALTER COLUMN.*TYPE` → 命中即 reject）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2776:2. **「default product_line / project」不是 NULL 而是 first-class row** — 不允許「product_line_id NULL = default」這種 implicit fallback 模式（會讓 query 兩條 path：`WHERE product_line_id IS NULL OR product_line_id = ?`、雙倍 index、雙倍 forensic 複雜度）；改採「seed 一行 product_line(`pl-default`) per tenant、id 寫死、`is_system=true` 不可刪、所有 legacy row backfill 為該 id」、同 S-4.6 既有「pl-default 不可被刪是 fallback bucket」設計斷言一致。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2777:3. **「default」字串前綴與 `t-default` 字串前綴對齊** — `t-default`（tenant）/ `pl-default`（product_line）/ `p-default`（project）/ `b-default`（branch）四級前綴、可一眼從字串判讀層級；避免短字串如 `default` 跨層共用造成 forensic / audit 訊息誤讀（log 看到「default」分不清是 tenant 還是 project）。
docs/priority-y/00-scenarios.md:2779:5. **既有 `t-default` 字串保留不改** — 即使「`tenant-default` 命名更好」也不改；alembic migration 0012 ～ 0029 是 immutable 歷史、改名 = breaking change = production 層需要走 ALTER TABLE 改 DEFAULT 改 backfilled row + 改 frontend hardcoded fallback + 改 migration 靜態列表（`scripts/migrate_sqlite_to_pg.py:223,339,...`）= 高風險 prod migration、ROI < 0；只有「可避免風險」的命名清理才在 Y10 考慮、S-9 不做。

docs/adr/ADR-0003-gerrit-code-review.md:76:Plus O6 path: a `merger-agent-bot` +2 is valid only on changes that carry the `Merge-Conflict-Resolved` hashtag (the merger sets this hashtag when it pushes a conflict-resolution patchset). On non-conflict changes the `Merger-Plus-2` requirement evaluates to `NOT_APPLICABLE`, so the merger's +2 is effectively ignored for the gate.
docs/adr/ADR-0003-gerrit-code-review.md:86:- Patchset-level Change-Id survives rebase — review history doesn't reset on every push.
docs/adr/ADR-0003-gerrit-code-review.md:87:- Declarative submit-requirements are auditable + testable (separate from any UI / GitLab logic), and Gerrit's UI surfaces the per-requirement status (`SATISFIED` / `UNSATISFIED` / `NOT_APPLICABLE`) directly on the change page.
docs/adr/ADR-0003-gerrit-code-review.md:92:- Gerrit operational complexity (Java service + dedicated DB; OpenID auth bridge; SSH key management for git push).
docs/adr/ADR-0003-gerrit-code-review.md:93:- Steep contributor learning curve (Change-Id hook, `refs/for/branch` push semantics, no GitHub-style "Files Changed" tab).

docs/sop/architecture-anti-patterns.md:472:**Symptom**: A migration / planning exercise dumps a large list (a `TODO.md`, a spreadsheet, an old tracker) into JIRA as hundreds of standalone tickets — summary only, no `area:` / `tier:` / `class:` labels, no fixVersion, no assignee, no AC section. But every project-wide query — `project = OP`, sprint review, "how big is the backlog?" — counts all of them, so the *visible* backlog is 3–5× the *actionable* backlog. The promise was "we'll refine these later"; nobody ever does, because there is no forcing function and the items are individually low-context.

   515	def _backpressure_state_file(
   516	    agent_class: str, instance_id: str | None = None
   517	) -> Path:
   518	    """Per-instance backpressure latch path.
   519	
   520	    Default instance keeps the legacy ``runner-backpressure-<class>.state``
   521	    name (so an existing single-instance runner restart picks up the
   522	    pre-existing latch). Non-default instances key on the bot username so
   523	    each ``codex-bot-N`` has its own quota state machine and doesn't pause
   524	    its siblings when its review queue saturates.
   525	    """
   526	    if instance_id is None:
   527	        instance_id = _instance_id_from_env()
   528	    if instance_id == DEFAULT_INSTANCE_ID:
   529	        return Path(f"/tmp/runner-backpressure-{agent_class}.state")
   530	    bot_username = resolve_bot_username(agent_class, instance_id)
   531	    return Path(f"/tmp/runner-backpressure-{bot_username}.state")
   532

   535	    """Runner-local operator alert hook.
   536

   538	    to assert single-fire behaviour, while production gets a grep-able
   539	    stdout alert even if the broader notification stack is unavailable.
   540	    """
   541	    print(f"[{channel}] {severity}: {detail}")
   542	
   543	
   544	def _gerrit_auth_for_bot(bot_username: str) -> tuple[str, Path]:
   545	    """Resolve (bot_username, ssh_key) for a Gerrit username.
   546	
   547	    Default-instance bots (``codex-bot``, ``claude-bot``) come from the
   548	    static ``_GERRIT_AUTH_BY_CLASS`` table to preserve legacy ssh-key
   549	    paths. Per-instance bots (``codex-bot-2`` etc., per OP-783) derive
   550	    their key path via ``_gerrit_ssh_key_for_bot``.
   551	    """
   552	    for username, key_path in _GERRIT_AUTH_BY_CLASS.values():
   553	        if username == bot_username:
   554	            return username, key_path
   555	    if bot_username.startswith(("codex-bot-", "claude-bot-")):
   556	        return bot_username, _gerrit_ssh_key_for_bot(bot_username)
   557	    raise ValueError(f"unknown Gerrit bot username: {bot_username}")

   560	def open_ps_count_for(bot_username: str) -> int:
   561	    """Return open Gerrit patchsets owned by ``bot_username``."""
   562	    user, ssh_key = _gerrit_auth_for_bot(bot_username)
   563	    cmd = [
   564	        "ssh", "-i", str(ssh_key), "-p", str(GERRIT_SSH_PORT),
   565	        f"{user}@{GERRIT_SSH_HOST}",
   566	        "gerrit", "query", "--format=JSON",
   567	        f"is:open owner:{bot_username}",
   568	    ]
   569	    out = BREAKERS["gerrit_ssh"].call(
   570	        subprocess.run, cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
   571	    )
   572	    n = 0
   573	    for line in out.stdout.splitlines():
   574	        try:
   575	            data = json.loads(line)
   576	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
   577	            continue
   578	        if data.get("type") == "stats":
   579	            n = int(data.get("rowCount", 0) or 0)
   580	    return n
   581	
   582	
   583	def backpressure_decide(
   584	    agent_class: str, instance_id: str | None = None
   585	) -> tuple[bool, str]:
   586	    """Hysteresis gate for runner pickup.
   587	
   588	    Returns ``(ok_to_pick_up, reason)``. A state file records only the
   589	    paused latch, so the runner re-notifies only when it crosses from
   590	    active to paused.
   591	
   592	    Per OP-783, the cap/floor and PS query are scoped to the per-instance
   593	    bot account: ``codex-bot-2`` saturating its review queue does not
   594	    pause ``codex-bot``. Default-instance behaviour (no env var, no
   595	    instance_id) is byte-identical to the pre-OP-783 path.
   596	    """
   597	    if instance_id is None:
   598	        instance_id = _instance_id_from_env()
   599	    bot_username, _ = _gerrit_auth_for_instance(agent_class, instance_id)
   600	
   601	    cap = settings.runner_ps_cap
   602	    floor = settings.runner_ps_floor
   603	    state_file = _backpressure_state_file(agent_class, instance_id)
   604	    paused = state_file.exists() and state_file.read_text().strip() == "paused"
   605	    n = open_ps_count_for(bot_username)
   606	
   607	    instance_tag = (
   608	        agent_class
   609	        if instance_id == DEFAULT_INSTANCE_ID
   610	        else f"{agent_class} (instance {instance_id}, {bot_username})"
   611	    )
   612	
   613	    if not paused and n >= cap:
   614	        state_file.write_text("paused")
   615	        notify_operator(
   616	            channel="runner-alerts",
   617	            severity="medium",
   618	            detail=(
   619	                f"{instance_tag} runner paused: {n} open PSes >= {cap}. "
   620	                "Please review + +2 to drain the queue."
   621	            ),
   622	        )
   623	        return False, f"{n} open PSes (cap {cap})"
   624	    if paused and n <= floor:
   625	        state_file.unlink()
   626	        return True, f"resumed: {n} open PSes (floor {floor})"
   627	    if paused:
   628	        return False, f"{n} open PSes (cap {cap}, floor {floor})"
   629	    return True, f"active: {n} open PSes (cap {cap})"
   630

   682	#  Per-tenant push identity (OP-1779 / 1A.2 — closes L6)
   683	# ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
   684	#
   685	# design §7 (per-tenant credential row), §8 (JIRA/project-namespace), §3 (L6).
   686	#
   687	# The shared on-disk bot SSH key + the fixed OmniSight Gerrit project
   688	# (``GERRIT_PROJECT_PATH``) are reserved for the internal ``omnisight-self``
   689	# tenant. Any customer tenant MUST push via a credential resolved from its
   690	# OWN ``git_accounts`` row (``git_credentials.get_credential_registry_async``)
   691	# scoped to the tenant's own Gerrit project. If no such row exists the push
   692	# fails closed rather than silently borrowing the bot key (L6): a customer run
   693	# can never push to OmniSight's — or another tenant's — project.
   694	#
   695	# Scope note: this covers the *push* identity (the ``git push`` to
   696	# ``refs/for/<target>`` and the recovery query / mergeability self-fix that
   697	# hang off a push). The develop-baseline *fetch* in the 1A.1 sync pipeline is
   698	# a separate concern and is intentionally left untouched here.
   699	
   700

   702	    """No tenant-scoped Gerrit push credential could be resolved.
   703	
   704	    Raised (and caught) inside :func:`push_to_gerrit_for_review` for any
   705	    non-``omnisight-self`` tenant when the per-tenant credential registry

docs/architecture/2026-06-14-conference-runner-class-scoping-design.md:8:> Do NOT spin up a dedicated runner instance per project (that explodes the runner count as projects grow). N projects → 0 new runners. This also fixes the mis-pickup at the ROOT (any runner that picks a conf ticket clones the RIGHT repo — there is no "wrong repo" anymore), rather than the scoped-class approach which only prevented certain runners from picking.

     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# OP-1137 / Sprint Boreas-C2 — Ephemeral cycle wrapper.
     3	#
     4	# Per-cycle lifecycle (replaces /tmp/runner_wrapper.sh which used shared
     5	# .git via `git worktree add`):
     6	#
     7	#   1. mktemp a fresh workspace at $WORKSPACE_ROOT/$INSTANCE/run-XXXXXX
     8	#   2. `git clone --reference $MIRROR_DIR --depth=50` into it (5-10s)
     9	#   3. Set OMNISIGHT_{CODEX,CLAUDE}_WORKTREE = workspace so the runner's
    10	#      CLI invocation chooses this directory as both cwd + worktree
    11	#   4. Invoke `python3 -u $workspace/auto-runner-jira.py` — runner reads
    12	#      itself from inside the ephemeral clone, so its capability_matrix /
    13	#      jira_dispatch / etc. are guaranteed in lockstep with the worktree
    14	#      (closes the OP-1126/1124 overnight bug class).
    15	#   5. rm -rf the workspace on any exit (trap EXIT covers SIGTERM, normal
    16	#      completion, internal error — but NOT SIGKILL; orphan sweep
    17	#      OP-1139 handles that residual class).
    18	#   6. Sleep 30s between cycles, repeat.
    19	#
    20	# Companion: scripts/runner-mirror/setup.sh + runner-mirror-fetch.timer
    21	# (OP-1136) keep the bare mirror fresh so step 2 stays fast.
    22	#
    23	# Usage:
    24	#   bash scripts/runner-wrapper/run-ephemeral.sh <instance> <agent_class> [<ignored>]
    25	#
    26	#   Third positional arg (worktree_path) is accepted for back-compat with
    27	#   the old wrapper signature but IGNORED — workspace is auto-created.
    28	
    29	set -u
    30	
    31	INSTANCE="$1"
    32	CLASS="$2"
    33	# $3 deliberately ignored (was worktree_path in legacy wrapper)
    34	
    35	LOG="/tmp/runner-$INSTANCE.log"
    36	
    37	# Auto-detect bot identity from agent_class. Operator can still pin any
    38	# of these via the matching OMNISIGHT_* env var (e.g., for testing or
    39	# per-instance accounts when those land).
    40	case "$CLASS" in
    41	    subscription-codex|api-openai)
    42	        DEFAULT_BOT="codex-bot"
    43	        ;;
    44	    *)
    45	        DEFAULT_BOT="claude-bot"
    46	        ;;
    47	esac
    48	
    49	WORKSPACE_ROOT="${OMNISIGHT_RUNNER_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-/tmp/runner-workspaces}"
    50	MIRROR_DIR="${OMNISIGHT_GIT_MIRROR_DIR:-$HOME/git-mirror/omnisight.git}"
    51	GERRIT_URL="${OMNISIGHT_GERRIT_URL:-ssh://${DEFAULT_BOT}@sora.services:29418/omnisight/OmniSight-Productizer}"
    52	SSH_KEY="${OMNISIGHT_GERRIT_SSH_KEY:-$HOME/.config/omnisight/gerrit-${DEFAULT_BOT}-ed25519}"
    53	CLONE_DEPTH="${OMNISIGHT_RUNNER_CLONE_DEPTH:-50}"
    54	CYCLE_SLEEP_S="${OMNISIGHT_RUNNER_CYCLE_SLEEP_S:-30}"
    55	
    56	mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$INSTANCE"
    57	
    58	echo "" >> "$LOG"
    59	echo "=== $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ephemeral wrapper started ===" >> "$LOG"
    60	echo "    instance=$INSTANCE class=$CLASS" >> "$LOG"
    61	echo "    workspace_root=$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$INSTANCE" >> "$LOG"
    62	echo "    mirror=$MIRROR_DIR" >> "$LOG"
    63	
    64	# Pre-flight: mirror must exist
    65	if [[ ! -d "$MIRROR_DIR" ]] || ! git -C "$MIRROR_DIR" rev-parse --is-bare-repository >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    66	    echo "[ephemeral-wrapper] ERROR: mirror not at $MIRROR_DIR — run scripts/runner-mirror/setup.sh first" >> "$LOG"
    67	    exit 2
    68	fi
    69	if [[ ! -f "$SSH_KEY" ]]; then
    70	    echo "[ephemeral-wrapper] ERROR: SSH key not found at $SSH_KEY" >> "$LOG"
    71	    exit 2
    72	fi
    73	
    74	export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i $SSH_KEY -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"
    75	
    76	cycle=0
    77	while true; do
    78	    cycle=$((cycle + 1))
    79	
    80	    # Workspace: fresh per cycle
    81	    workspace=$(mktemp -d "$WORKSPACE_ROOT/$INSTANCE/run-XXXXXX")
    82	    # trap covers normal exit, SIGTERM, SIGINT, and the while-loop's `continue`.
    83	    # SIGKILL of this script itself orphans the workspace — handled by OP-1139 sweeper.
    84	    cleanup() { [[ -n "${workspace:-}" && -d "$workspace" ]] && rm -rf "$workspace"; }
    85	    trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
    86	
    87	    echo "" >> "$LOG"
    88	    echo "=== $(date '+%H:%M:%S') $INSTANCE cycle #$cycle start workspace=$workspace ===" >> "$LOG"
    89

    91	    # Shallow (--depth=50) keeps the working tree minimal; full history
    92	    # is available through the alternates pointer back to the mirror.

    97	        rm -rf "$workspace"

   113	    git_user_email="${OMNISIGHT_GIT_USER_EMAIL:-rt3628+${DEFAULT_BOT}@gmail.com}"
   114	    git -C "$workspace" config user.name "$git_user_name"
   115	    git -C "$workspace" config user.email "$git_user_email"
   116	
   117	    # Invoke runner Python from inside the ephemeral clone.
   118	    # OMNISIGHT_{CODEX,CLAUDE}_WORKTREE pinned to the workspace so the
   119	    # runner's CLI invocation uses this dir as both cwd + worktree.
   120	    # OMNISIGHT_RUNNER_EPHEMERAL=1 is a hint flag — auto-runner-jira.py
   121	    # (per OP-1138 / C3) can use it to assert workspace==REPO invariant.
   122	    cd "$workspace"
   123	    PATH="/home/user/.nvm/versions/node/v24.14.1/bin:$PATH" \

   125	    OMNISIGHT_RUNNER_EPHEMERAL=1 \

   127	    OMNISIGHT_CODEX_WORKTREE="$workspace" \
   128	    OMNISIGHT_CLAUDE_WORKTREE="$workspace" \
   129	    python3 -u "$workspace/auto-runner-jira.py" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
   130	    rc=$?
   131	    cd - >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   132	
   133	    echo "=== $(date '+%H:%M:%S') $INSTANCE cycle #$cycle end rc=$rc ===" >> "$LOG"
   134	
   135	    cleanup
   136	    trap - EXIT INT TERM
   137	
   138	    sleep "$CYCLE_SLEEP_S"

     1	"""External product contribution orchestration (OP-1846 / P2.4.3a).
     2	
     3	Composes the B2 source resolver, clone-at-base mechanics, and GitHub PR target
     4	into a library-only flow. The feature authoring step is an injected callable so
     5	the autonomous runner and real agent invocation remain out of this module.
     6	"""
     7	from __future__ import annotations
     8	
     9	import asyncio
    10	import inspect
    11	import re
    12	import subprocess
    13	from dataclasses import dataclass
    14	from pathlib import Path
    15	from typing import Awaitable, Callable
    16	
    17	from backend.agents.github_pr_target import PrResult, open_contribution_pr
    18	from backend.agents.product_build import _repo_dir_name, _url_with_token
    19	from backend.agents.product_source import resolve_product_source
    20	
    21	
    22	class ContributionError(RuntimeError):
    23	    """A product contribution could not be prepared safely."""
    24	
    25	
    26	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    27	class ContributionResult:
    28	    branch: str
    29	    pr: PrResult | None
    30	    no_changes: bool

    33	def _sanitize_slug(slug: str) -> str:
    34	    value = re.sub(r"[\s_]+", "-", slug.strip().lower())
    35	    value = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]+", "", value)
    36	    value = re.sub(r"-+", "-", value).strip("-")
    37	    return value or "change"
    38	
    39	
    40	def _run(
    41	    cmd: list[str],
    42	    *,
    43	    cwd: Path | None = None,
    44	    redact: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    45	):
    46	    proc = subprocess.run(
    47	        cmd,
    48	        cwd=str(cwd) if cwd is not None else None,
    49	        text=True,
    50	        capture_output=True,
    51	        check=False,
    52	    )
    53	    if proc.returncode != 0:
    54	        detail = (proc.stderr or proc.stdout or "").strip()
    55	        for secret in redact:
    56	            if secret:
    57	                detail = detail.replace(secret, "<redacted>")
    58	        raise ContributionError(f"{cmd[:2]} failed: {detail}")
    59	    return proc
    60	
    61	
    62	async def _resolve_git_account(
    63	    git_account_ref: str,
    64	    *,
    65	    tenant_id: str | None,
    66	) -> dict:
    67	    if not git_account_ref:
    68	        raise ContributionError("git_account_ref is required")
    69	
    70	    from backend import git_credentials
    71	
    72	    row = await git_credentials.pick_by_id(git_account_ref, tenant_id=tenant_id)
    73	    if row is None:
    74	        raise ContributionError(f"git_accounts row {git_account_ref!r} not found")
    75	    return row
    76	
    77	
    78	def _commit_message(ticket_key: str) -> str:
    79	    env_name = _git_config(["git", "config", "--get", "user.name"])
    80	    env_email = _git_config(["git", "config", "--get", "user.email"])
    81	    global_name = _git_config(["git", "config", "--global", "--get", "user.name"])
    82	    global_email = _git_config(["git", "config", "--global", "--get", "user.email"])
    83	
    84	    return "\n".join([
    85	        f"{ticket_key} product contribution",
    86	        "",
    87	        f"Automated contribution for {ticket_key}.",
    88	        "",
    89	        "Co-Authored-By: GPT-5.5 (codex-cli) <noreply@openai.com>",
    90	        f"Co-Authored-By: {env_name} <{env_email}>",
    91	        f"Co-Authored-By: {global_name} <{global_email}>",
    92	    ])

    94	
    95	def _git_config(cmd: list[str]) -> str:
    96	    proc = subprocess.run(
    97	        cmd,
    98	        text=True,
    99	        capture_output=True,
   100	        check=False,
   101	    )
   102	    value = (proc.stdout or "").strip()
   103	    return value or "unconfigured"
   104	
   105	
   106	async def contribute_to_product(
   107	    project_key: str,
   108	    *,
   109	    ticket_key: str,
   110	    base: str,
   111	    slug: str,
   112	    implement: Callable[[Path], Awaitable[None] | None],
   113	    git_account_ref: str,
   114	    workspace_root: Path,
   115	    tenant_id: str | None = None,
   116	) -> ContributionResult:
   117	    source = resolve_product_source(project_key)
   118	    if source is None:
   119	        raise ContributionError(
   120	            "project not configured for external-source contribution"
   121	        )
   122	
   123	    cred = await _resolve_git_account(git_account_ref, tenant_id=tenant_id)
   124	    token_url = _url_with_token(source.repo_url, cred)
   125	    token = str(cred.get("token") or "").strip()
   126	    clean_url = source.repo_url
   127	
   128	    workspace_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   129	    worktree = workspace_root / _repo_dir_name(source.repo_url)
   130	    branch = f"feature/{ticket_key}-{_sanitize_slug(slug)}"
   131	
   132	    _run(["git", "clone", token_url, str(worktree)], redact=(token,))
   133	    # Fetch/checkout the base under the AUTHENTICATED origin first; only then
   134	    # scrub the token. A private base cannot be fetched once origin is
   135	    # de-tokenised, so the scrub must follow every auth'd fetch (OP-1846 fix —
   136	    # the token window stays bounded to clone+fetch+checkout, before implement()).
   137	    _run(["git", "fetch", "origin", base], cwd=worktree)
   138	    _run(["git", "checkout", "-B", base, f"origin/{base}"], cwd=worktree)
   139	    _run(["git", "checkout", "-b", branch], cwd=worktree)
   140	    _run(["git", "remote", "set-url", "origin", clean_url], cwd=worktree)
   141	
   142	    # OP-1855: pre-set a usable git identity in the fresh clone so the agent can
   143	    # commit without scrambling for one (canary finding: agents naturally commit
   144	    # their changes; a missing identity blocks them and pollutes the commit author
   145	    # with whatever fallback they invent).
   146	    _run(["git", "config", "user.name", "OmniSight Runner"], cwd=worktree)
   147	    _run(["git", "config", "user.email", "runner@omnisight.local"], cwd=worktree)
   148	
   149	    result = implement(worktree)
   150	    if inspect.isawaitable(result):
   151	        await result
   152	
   153	    # OP-1855: accept agent-made commits. The pre-OP-1855 check looked only at
   154	    # `git status --porcelain` (working-tree changes) and treated a clean WT as
   155	    # no-changes — but if the agent committed its own changes (which is normal),
   156	    # the WT is clean even though the branch has real commits ahead of base, and
   157	    # those commits would be lost when the tempdir is torn down. So now: "work
   158	    # exists" iff the WT is dirty OR the branch has commits ahead of base.
   159	    status = _run(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=worktree)
   160	    wt_dirty = bool((status.stdout or "").strip())
   161	    ahead = _run(["git", "rev-list", "--count", f"{base}..{branch}"], cwd=worktree)
   162	    try:
   163	        commits_ahead = int((ahead.stdout or "0").strip() or 0) > 0
   164	    except ValueError:
   165	        commits_ahead = False
   166	
   167	    if not wt_dirty and not commits_ahead:
   168	        return ContributionResult(branch=branch, pr=None, no_changes=True)
   169	
   170	    if wt_dirty:
   171	        # Agent left uncommitted changes (the original path); we commit them.
   172	        _run(["git", "add", "-A"], cwd=worktree)
   173	        _run(["git", "commit", "-m", _commit_message(ticket_key)], cwd=worktree)
   174	    # else: agent committed already; nothing for us to add/commit — push as-is.
   175	
   176	    # open_contribution_pr is synchronous and resolves its credential via an
   177	    # internal asyncio.run(), so it must NOT be invoked from this coroutine's
   178	    # running loop (it raises "must be called from synchronous runner code").
   179	    # Bridge through a worker thread (OP-1846 fix) — idiomatic for calling sync
   180	    # blocking I/O from async code, and it leaves merged OP-1845 untouched.
   181	    pr = await asyncio.to_thread(
   182	        open_contribution_pr,
   183	        worktree=worktree,
   184	        branch=branch,
   185	        base=base,
   186	        title=f"{ticket_key}: {slug}",
   187	        body=(
   188	            f"Automated camviewpro contribution for {ticket_key}.\n\n"
   189	            "Generated through the OP-1846 contribution orchestrator."
   190	        ),
   191	        git_account_ref=git_account_ref,
   192	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
   193	    )
   194	    return ContributionResult(branch=branch, pr=pr, no_changes=False)

  1768	def _camviewpro_label_value(labels, prefix: str) -> str | None:
  1769	    for label in labels or ():

     6	sweep only fires on the *next* claim attempt for the same instance, so a

     8	
     9	This module is a standalone sweeper, invoked by a 10-minute systemd timer

    95	# ── Heartbeat check ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    96	
    97	
    98	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    99	class HeartbeatStatus:
   100	    """Outcome of one heartbeat probe. ``alive`` is True iff the file
   101	    exists, parses, and its PID is currently a live process on this host
   102	    (OP-783 single-host invariant — cross-host probes are out of scope)."""
   103	
   104	    alive: bool
   105	    reason: str
   106	    pid: int | None = None
   107	
   108	
   109	def _pid_alive(pid: int) -> bool:
   110	    if pid <= 0:
   111	        return False
   112	    try:
   113	        os.kill(pid, 0)
   114	    except ProcessLookupError:
   115	        return False
   116	    except PermissionError:
   117	        # PID exists, owned by another user — still alive.
   118	        return True
   119	    except OSError:
   120	        return False
   121	    return True
   122	
   123	
   124	def heartbeat_path(instance_id: str, epoch_us: int, ticket_key: str,
   125	                   root: Path | None = None) -> Path:
   126	    """Construct the well-known heartbeat path for a claim."""
   127	    return (root or _HEARTBEAT_ROOT) / instance_id / f"{epoch_us}-{ticket_key}" / "heartbeat"
   128	
   129	
   130	def probe_heartbeat(instance_id: str, epoch_us: int, ticket_key: str,
   131	                    root: Path | None = None) -> HeartbeatStatus:
   132	    """Resolve the runner-liveness signal for one claim.
   133	
   134	    The heartbeat file is expected to contain JSON of the form
   135	    ``{"pid": <int>, ...}`` written by the runner at pickup. Any
   136	    failure path (missing file, malformed JSON, missing/non-int pid,
   137	    dead pid) returns ``alive=False`` with a descriptive ``reason``.
   138	    """
   139	    path = heartbeat_path(instance_id, epoch_us, ticket_key, root=root)
   140	    try:
   141	        raw = path.read_text()
   142	    except FileNotFoundError:
   143	        return HeartbeatStatus(alive=False, reason="heartbeat-file-absent")
   144	    except OSError as exc:
   145	        return HeartbeatStatus(alive=False, reason=f"heartbeat-read-error:{type(exc).__name__}")
   146	
   147	    try:
   148	        data = json.loads(raw)
   149	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
   150	        return HeartbeatStatus(alive=False, reason="heartbeat-malformed-json")
   151	
   152	    pid = data.get("pid") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
   153	    if not isinstance(pid, int):
   154	        return HeartbeatStatus(alive=False, reason="heartbeat-missing-pid")
   155	
   156	    if not _pid_alive(pid):
   157	        return HeartbeatStatus(alive=False, reason="heartbeat-pid-dead", pid=pid)
   158	
   159	    return HeartbeatStatus(alive=True, reason="heartbeat-pid-alive", pid=pid)
   160	
   161

   165	@dataclass(frozen=True)
   166	class OrphanCandidate:
   167	    """One TTL-exceeded fenced claim label on an In-Progress ticket. A
   168	    single ticket can stack multiple claim labels (winner + loser tokens
   169	    from same-instance peers); the reaper picks the oldest to drive the
   170	    heartbeat probe, and ``release_ticket_claim`` strips all of that
   171	    instance's labels in one pass."""
   172	
   173	    ticket_key: str
   174	    instance_id: str
   175	    token: str
   176	    epoch_us: int
   177	    age_seconds: float
   178	
   179	
   180	def classify_in_progress_issue(issue: dict, *, now_us: int, ttl_s: int) -> OrphanCandidate | None:
   181	    """Return an :class:`OrphanCandidate` if this ticket has a TTL-exceeded
   182	    fenced claim label, else ``None``. Pre-AUDIT-24 bare ``claim:{instance}``
   183	    labels carry no epoch and are deferred to the next claimer's stale sweep."""
   184	    key = issue.get("key") or "?"
   185	    fields = issue.get("fields") or {}
   186	    labels = list(fields.get("labels") or [])
   187	
   188	    oldest: OrphanCandidate | None = None
   189	    for label in labels:
   190	        parsed = _parse_claim_label(label)
   191	        if parsed is None:
   192	            continue
   193	        instance_id, token = parsed
   194	        if token is None:
   195	            # Legacy bare claim — no token, no age signal. Defer to the
   196	            # next claimer's stale sweep.
   197	            continue
   198	        epoch_us = _claim_token_epoch_us(token)
   199	        if epoch_us is None:
   200	            continue
   201	        age_s = (now_us - epoch_us) / 1_000_000
   202	        if age_s <= ttl_s:
   203	            continue
   204	        if oldest is None or epoch_us < oldest.epoch_us:
   205	            oldest = OrphanCandidate(
   206	                ticket_key=key,
   207	                instance_id=instance_id,
   208	                token=token,
   209	                epoch_us=epoch_us,
   210	                age_seconds=age_s,
   211	            )
   212	    return oldest

  1772	        )

  1777	            break

  1780	        note = (

  1782	            f"push error; retrying in {backoff}s"
  1783	        )

  1786	        time.sleep(backoff)

  1790	
  1791	    if result.returncode != 0:

  1794	            detail = "\n".join([*retry_notes, detail])
  1795	        if change_id and retry_notes:

  1799	                )

     1	"""OP-1778 (1A.1) — runner tenant-label binding + per-tenant workspace.
     2	
     3	This module is the single place where the runner turns a JIRA ticket's
     4	``tenant:<tid>`` label into (a) a tenant id to bind into the DB/FS context
     5	via :func:`backend.db_context.set_tenant_id` and (b) a per-tenant workspace
     6	directory under :mod:`backend.tenant_fs`.
     7	
     8	Design contract (design §5/§7/§12/§13):
     9	
    10	* **Label decision (§12).** A ticket carries at most one ``tenant:<tid>``
    11	  label. The matched ``<tid>`` is validated against the same id grammar
    12	  :mod:`backend.tenant_fs` enforces for on-disk roots, so a label can never
    13	  widen the filesystem namespace.
    14	* **Back-compat default (§13).** A label-less (internal) ticket defaults to
    15	  ``omnisight-self``. ``omnisight-self`` is *not* a customer tenant and is
    16	  deliberately distinct from :data:`backend.tenant_fs._DEFAULT_TENANT`
    17	  (``t-default``) so an internal ticket can never silently inherit a
    18	  customer-tenant default. For ``omnisight-self`` the runner keeps using the
    19	  existing per-agent-class sibling worktree — i.e. it behaves exactly as it
    20	  did before this ticket.
    21	* **Per-tenant workspace (§5/§7).** A customer tenant gets a freshly cloned
    22	  workspace under ``data/tenants/<tid>/workspace`` with its **own** git dir
    23	  and a **fully independent object store** — no ``git worktree`` gitlink and
    24	  no ``objects/info/alternates`` bind back to the host repo (closes L8-fs).
    25	"""
    26	
    27	from __future__ import annotations
    28	
    29	import re
    30	import subprocess
    31	from pathlib import Path
    32	from typing import Callable, Iterable

    34	from backend import tenant_fs

    36	# The internal/self tenant. Label-less tickets default here (§13). Kept
    37	# distinct from tenant_fs._DEFAULT_TENANT ("t-default") on purpose so an
    38	# internal ticket never inherits a customer-tenant default.
    39	OMNISIGHT_SELF_TENANT = "omnisight-self"
    40	
    41	# JIRA label that binds a ticket to a tenant, e.g. ``tenant:t-foo``.
    42	TENANT_LABEL_PREFIX = "tenant:"
    43	
    44	# Subdirectory under the tenant data root that holds the cloned working tree.
    45	_WORKSPACE_DIRNAME = "workspace"
    46	
    47	# Mirrors tenant_fs._TID_RE — a label must not be able to escape the on-disk
    48	# tenant namespace grammar.
    49	_TID_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$")
    50	
    51	
    52	class TenantLabelError(ValueError):
    53	    """Raised when a ticket's ``tenant:`` label(s) are malformed or conflict."""
    54	
    55	
    56	class TenantWorkspaceError(RuntimeError):
    57	    """Raised when a per-tenant workspace cannot be allocated in isolation."""
    58	
    59	
    60	def _validate_tid(tid: str) -> str:
    61	    if not tid or not _TID_RE.match(tid):
    62	        raise TenantLabelError(f"invalid tenant id in label: {tid!r}")
    63	    return tid
    64	
    65	
    66	def resolve_tenant_id(labels: Iterable[str]) -> str:
    67	    """Resolve the tenant id from a ticket's labels.
    68	
    69	    Scans *labels* for ``tenant:<tid>`` (prefix match is case-insensitive;
    70	    the ``<tid>`` is preserved verbatim and validated). Returns the single
    71	    matched, validated tenant id, or :data:`OMNISIGHT_SELF_TENANT` when no
    72	    ``tenant:`` label is present (§13 back-compat).
    73	
    74	    Raises :class:`TenantLabelError` when more than one *distinct* tenant is
    75	    requested, or when the matched id is malformed.
    76	    """
    77	    tids: list[str] = []
    78	    for raw in labels or ():
    79	        label = (raw or "").strip()
    80	        if label.lower().startswith(TENANT_LABEL_PREFIX):
    81	            tids.append(label[len(TENANT_LABEL_PREFIX):].strip())
    82	
    83	    distinct = sorted(set(tids))
    84	    if not distinct:
    85	        return OMNISIGHT_SELF_TENANT
    86	    if len(distinct) > 1:
    87	        raise TenantLabelError(
    88	            f"conflicting tenant labels on one ticket: {distinct}"
    89	        )
    90	    return _validate_tid(distinct[0])
    91	
    92	
    93	def is_self_tenant(tenant_id: str) -> bool:
    94	    """True for the internal/self tenant (keeps the legacy worktree path)."""
    95	    return tenant_id == OMNISIGHT_SELF_TENANT
    96

    99	    """Per-tenant workspace dir: ``data/tenants/<tid>/workspace``.
   100	
   101	    Reuses :func:`backend.tenant_fs.tenant_data_root` so the workspace lives
   102	    inside the same physically isolated tenant namespace as the tenant's
   103	    artifacts/backups/ingest roots.
   104	    """
   105	    return tenant_fs.tenant_data_root(tenant_id) / _WORKSPACE_DIRNAME
   106	
   107	
   108	def build_clone_argv(source_repo: Path | str, dest: Path | str) -> list[str]:
   109	    """Argv for a fully-isolated clone of *source_repo* into *dest*.
   110	
   111	    ``--no-local`` forces git's object-transfer transport even for a local
   112	    source path, so objects are **copied** rather than hardlinked or shared
   113	    via ``objects/info/alternates``. That is what gives the tenant clone an
   114	    independent object store (the L8-fs isolation contract); a plain local
   115	    ``git clone`` would hardlink the host repo's objects.
   116	    """
   117	    return ["git", "clone", "--no-local", str(source_repo), str(dest)]
   118	
   119	
   120	def assert_isolated_git_dir(workspace: Path) -> None:
   121	    """Assert *workspace* has its own git dir and no shared object store.
   122	
   123	    Fails closed (raises :class:`TenantWorkspaceError`) when the workspace is
   124	    not a git repo, when ``.git`` is a gitlink file (the ``git worktree``
   125	    pattern, which shares the host object store), or when an
   126	    ``objects/info/alternates`` file binds the object store to another repo.
   127	    """
   128	    git_dir = workspace / ".git"
   129	    if not git_dir.exists():
   130	        raise TenantWorkspaceError(
   131	            f"tenant workspace {workspace} is not a git repo (no .git)"
   132	        )
   133	    if git_dir.is_file():
   134	        raise TenantWorkspaceError(
   135	            f"tenant workspace {workspace}/.git is a gitlink (shared worktree); "
   136	            "an isolated tenant clone must own its git dir"
   137	        )
   138	    alternates = git_dir / "objects" / "info" / "alternates"
   139	    if alternates.exists():
   140	        raise TenantWorkspaceError(
   141	            f"tenant workspace {workspace} shares an object store via "
   142	            f"{alternates} (alternates bind); isolation contract violated"
   143	        )
